content.text: The Pitt Season 2: How Many Episodes Are There In the Show?The Pitt Season 2 is set to release on January 8th, 2026, on HBO Max, and it will be diving right back into that real-time, pressure-cooker vibe the show is known for. Just like Season 1, the new chapter is expected to have 15 episodes following a weekly schedule as it did previously.Created by R. Scott Gemmill, the series consists of shocking medical emergency cases of an underfunded ER. Noah Wyle is back as Dr. Robby Robinavitch, trying to keep the ship afloat with familiar faces like Katherine Lanasa, Fiona Dourif, Isa Briones, and the rest of the crew returning.
